name: idle-stop
description: Stops a game server automatically once the last player leaves, and adds player administration: live player list, kick, ban, ban list, a nuclear reset, and a welcome message. Player data comes from an A2S query (Source/GoldSrc) or Source-RCON output (Minecraft and custom games).
author: SpiritNetworks

permissionDescriptions.server.write: Required on the caller to change Idle Stop settings, kick/ban players, clear bans, or stop an empty server through the Idle Stop API.
permissionDescriptions.idle-stop.console: Reads server console output inside the panel to detect player joins so welcome messages can be sent the moment a player joins.

enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no background checks run at all.

autoManage.description: Manage every running server by default. Leave off and opt in per server for safety.

gamePreset.description: Default behavior for games not detected automatically.

graceSeconds.description: How long the server must stay at or below the empty threshold before it is stopped.

emptyThreshold.description: Player count at or below which the server counts as empty.

minServerUptimeSeconds.description: Never stop a server within this many seconds of it being seen running.

stopMethod.description: How the server is stopped: send a console command, or ask the node agent to stop the container.

stopCommand.description: Console command used to stop the server. Empty uses the preset (stop for Minecraft, quit for Source/GoldSrc).

stopRetrySeconds.description: After a stop is issued, wait at least this long before issuing another.

playerSource.description: How the online player count is read when no player list is available.

playerCommand.description: RCON command that prints the player count (custom games).

playerRegex.description: Regex with one capture group for the player count, applied to the RCON output.

playerListCommand.description: RCON command whose output lists players (Source: status, Minecraft: list).

banListCommand.description: RCON command whose output lists bans (Source: listid, Minecraft/ValheimRcon: banlist).

rosterJoinRegex.description: Valheim only: console line pattern for a join; capture group 1 is the SteamID. Empty uses the preset (Got connection SteamID).

rosterLeaveRegex.description: Valheim only: console line pattern for a leave; capture group 1 is the SteamID. Empty uses the preset (Closing socket).

queryHost.description: A2S query host when it differs from the server's primary IP (required if the primary IP is 0.0.0.0).

queryPort.description: A2S query port. 0 uses the server's primary port.

rconHost.description: RCON host when it differs from the server's primary IP (required if the primary IP is 0.0.0.0).

rconPort.description: RCON port. 0 uses the server's primary port (ValheimRcon defaults to game port + 2).

rconPassword.description: RCON password. Leave empty to auto-detect from server.properties or server.cfg through the file tunnel.

welcomeEnabled.description: Welcome players when they are first seen online.

welcomeMessage.description: Welcome text. {player} and {server} are replaced. Source/GoldSrc broadcast with say; Minecraft uses tell.

welcomeOnExisting.description: Also welcome players who were already online the first time the plugin saw them.

welcomeConsole.description: Welcome the moment a player joins by reading live console output. Falls back to polling if console output is unavailable.

welcomeJoinRegex.description: Regex matched against console lines to detect joins; capture group 1 is the player name. Empty uses the preset pattern.

defaultBanMinutes.description: Default ban length in minutes when the caller leaves it out (0 = permanent). Source/GoldSrc only.

defaultBanReason.description: Default ban reason when the caller leaves it out.

idle-stop:empty.description: Emitted when a managed server is first observed empty (grace period starts).

idle-stop:stopped.description: Emitted after the plugin issues a stop for an empty server.

idle-stop:welcomed.description: Emitted after a welcome message is sent to a joining player.

idle-stop:kicked.description: Emitted after a kick command is sent.

idle-stop:banned.description: Emitted after a ban command is sent.

idle-stop:unbanned.description: Emitted after an unban command is sent.

idle-stop:bans-cleared.description: Emitted after the local ban list for a server is cleared.

idle-stop:nuclear.description: Emitted after the nuclear reset (kick all + clear bans).
